label: Business calendar
description: Working hours in one time zone, minus holidays, used to measure SLA goals in business time. Hours are local wall-clock times, so after a daylight-saving change 09:00 is still 09:00.
usage: One calendar per support team or region, e.g. "London office hours".
Split a lunch break or hours that cross midnight into two intervals.
constraints: id is unique; tenant calendars start with tenant__. Default calendars can be changed, not removed; a calendar an SLA policy uses cannot be removed.
timeZone is an IANA name such as Europe/London; day is mon–sun; start and end are HH:mm with end after start (24:00 allowed) and intervals of a day do not overlap.
Holidays are YYYY-MM-DD local dates, at most 400.
Running SLA clocks keep the calendar they started with.

binding.description: Configuration object in a layer's spec catalog; not a layout node.

examples.description: Weekday office hours with a holiday
